svg.title: Vibro-compaction probe — Djúpaþjöppun með titurprófa
svg.desc: A long suspended shaft lowers a thick pointed vibrating probe into the soil, with two separated vibration arcs.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-vibro-compaction","label_en":"Vibro-compaction probe","label_is":"Djúpaþjöppun með titurprófa","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["ground-improvement","compaction"],"description":"A long suspended shaft lowers a thick pointed vibrating probe into the soil, with two separated vibration arcs.","design_note":"The buried torpedo-shaped vibrator and lateral vibration marks distinguish vibro-compaction from cone testing.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
